author: EmuCore - Hub
title: 1999 - Playstation 2 Revealed [The Console, First Games and Developer Impressions]
summary: An archival PlayStation Underground segment preserves the 1999 public reveal of PlayStation 2, combining the announced console and early games with contemporary developer impressions before launch expectations hardened into retrospective history.

blocks.text: The six-minute recording is valuable because it retains the vocabulary and uncertainty of the reveal period. Its metadata identifies the official 1999 announcement, interviews and early material for Ridge Racer, Tekken Tag Tournament, The Bouncer, Kessen, Dark Cloud and Gran Turismo 2000. Rather than explaining PS2 through later sales records, it shows what Sony and developers chose to demonstrate while the machine was still a promise. Those selections expose the initial emphasis on character detail, motion, simulation and generational spectacle.

The upload is an archival excerpt credited to PlayStation Underground, not a complete press conference or an independently balanced account. Its title and keywords do not document the exact recording date, edit history, speakers or whether every listed project reached release in the shown form. Contemporary promotional claims should be treated as expectations, not verified performance. Preserve it for first-hand atmosphere and announced priorities, then use period reporting and final software to evaluate how the reveal translated into the shipped platform.
